units: SVG user units of assets/solaro-mark.svg (y down). solaro-logo.svg uses the same mark at the same coordinates.
primitive: Every shape = a CxC cell with per-corner radii [tl,tr,br,bl] (0..R) and an optional centred hole (2r x 2r) with its own per-corner radii. All arcs are circular (cubic handle = 0.5523*radius).

quarter_TR.note: big quarter-circle corner (centre 346.882,102.059) faces the mark centre; small r 23.753 at outer corner

quarter_BL.note: TR corner R (centre 102.046,346.951) faces centre; BL corner r 23.753. = quarter_TR rotated 180 deg

pin_BR.note: circle with BR quadrant squared (outer corner r 28.237, hole corner sharp at 395.876,395.865); reads as a map pin / teardrop / the wordmark 'a'

fill.type: linear vertical gradient per shape bbox

group_inner_shadow.note: thin dark rim on top/left inner edges -> slightly debossed look

lockup_solaro_logo_svg.note: (l-top 68 + o-bottom 381)/2 = 224.5 = mark centre: wordmark is vertically centred on the mark
lockup_solaro_logo_svg.live_site_variant: logo-3.svg (2157x477): same shapes, mark 476.5 tall, wordmark ~9.7% larger relative to mark, gap 133.5 (=126 at 449 scale), baseline 413.46 (=389.6 at 449 scale)

wordmark.construction: Poppins Bold (700) skeleton: S/o/l match Poppins Bold at font-size 392.2 units (S drawn ~4% taller, l ~6% taller). 'a' and 'r' are custom: 'a' = single-storey bowl whose right side rounds over the top (no square shoulder) into a stem with flat foot; 'r' = full arch (n-shape) whose right leg is cut horizontally at y=254.2-255.5 (terminal 64.9 wide).
